prompt.en: Explain how India protects people on the coast and fishers at sea from a cyclone. Name four parts of this work and say what each one does.

label.en: Cyclone Warning Services and Marine Weather Services monitor storms along both coasts, continuously.

level1.en: Who monitors storms, and on which coasts?

clue.en: India has several Cyclone Warning Services and Marine Weather Services, and they cover the eastern and western coasts.

level2Template.en: Storms along both the eastern and western coasts are monitored by ___.

accepted: Cyclone Warning Services and Marine Weather Services

label.en: The National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project builds cyclone shelters, strengthens warning systems and improves emergency response.

clue.en: This project works in cyclone-prone States and Union Territories.

accepted: the National Cyclone Risk Mitigation Project

label.en: INCOIS with IMD set up the Storm Surge Early Warning System, which forecasts storm surges and how far the water spreads.

level1.en: Which system forecasts the water, and not the wind?

clue.en: This system was set up by INCOIS in collaboration with IMD.

level2Template.en: Storm surges and how far the water spreads are forecast by ___.

accepted: the Storm Surge Early Warning System

label.en: GEMINI receives satellite data and passes it by Bluetooth to a phone, which shows alerts to fishers at sea.

level1.en: How does a warning reach a boat at sea?

clue.en: A handheld device receives data from the GAGAN satellite and sends it to a mobile phone.

level2Template.en: At sea, fishers receive alerts through a handheld device called ___.

text.en: India's protection from cyclones has several parts, and each part has its own task.
Storms along both the eastern and western coasts are monitored by ___.
Storm surges and how far the water spreads are forecast by ___.
At sea, fishers receive alerts through a handheld device called ___.

explanation.en: Warning services watch the storm, NCRMP builds shelters and strengthens warnings, SSEWS forecasts the surge, and GEMINI carries alerts to fishers at sea.
